Orange drink: 10L total. Spilled 1L, so 9L remains.
Water in orange (2/3 of 10): $10 \times 2/3 = 20/3$.
Spilled 1L (assuming 2/3 is water): $1 \times 2/3 = 2/3$.
Remaining water in orange: $20/3 - 2/3 = 18/3 = 6$ liters.
Pineapple drink: 15L total, 3/5 is water.
Water in pineapple: $15 \times 3/5 = 9$ liters.
Total water: $6 + 9 = 15$ liters.
